Henley offers to bring cones for the soccer practice session. This is mentioned in the conversation on October 3rd, where he states, "I'll bring some cones so we can set up drills and practice! Let’s make sure we work on the weak spots from our last matches." The cones will be used to structure the practice and improve specific areas of the players' skills, particularly since Farrah suggests focusing on defense improvements during the drills. Henley's contribution is acknowledged as a practical and helpful idea for enhancing the training routine.
